source_baseline: DDD-BDM-010 + 2026-09-14 G1 revalidation + ADR-019/020/021 + global Strategic convergence + 2026-09-15 Application Deployment Boundary Challenge

participants.name: Business Connectivity
participants.responsibility: Business Process meaning/responsibility, application-semantic Connectivity Need, business attribution and justification reconciliation.

participants.name: Access Governance
participants.responsibility: Access Request history, source/destination approval obligations, side decisions, bilateral authorization grant, withdrawal/revocation and governance provenance.

participants.name: Access Policy
participants.responsibility: Authoritative current Policy Rule truth and effective authorized-policy projection.

participants.name: Authority Management
participants.responsibility: Effective scoped actor/action authority and role/group/scope assignment semantics.

participants.name: Resource Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Resource identity/lifecycle, Resource Scope Affiliation/responsibility and current/historical corporate-visible technical realization.

participants.name: Application Communication Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Application/Component/Interaction identities and immutable interaction traffic contracts.

participants.name: Application Deployment
participants.responsibility: Logical ApplicationDeployment identity/lifecycle and Component-to-Resource placement truth.

participants.name: Network Enforcement Placement
participants.responsibility: Candidate enforcement-location relevance plus applicable policy/ACL locators.

participants.name: Technical Access Evidence
participants.responsibility: Normalized source-qualified technical evidence with provenance/time/source scope and no authorization/current-policy claim.

participants.name: Access Policy Realization
participants.responsibility: Source-neutral required-vs-configured effective-policy assessment, semantic reconciliation, vendor-neutral change design and proposed-result semantic verification.

participants.name: Network Environment Operations
participants.responsibility: Controlled provider/device mutation operation identity, mutation-authority admission, concurrency/preconditions, outcome and execution provenance.

participants.name: Required Policy Materialization
participants.responsibility: Derive normalized required technical predicates from AP, ACC, AD, RC and NEP public contracts; unresolved inputs remain explicit.

relationships.purpose: Let Connectivity Need refer to application-semantic communication.
Supply business basis without making Need equal permission.
Let AD place application Components without importing ACC internals.
Let AD own Component-to-Resource placement while RC retains Resource truth.
Supply immutable application communication semantics for the governed subject.
Supply stable logical deployment applicability for the governed subject.

relationships.contract: ResourceRef + logicalTime -> effective ResourceScopeAffiliation[] with validity/provenance
relationships.purpose: Supply responsibility-scope facts used to establish approval obligations.
Publish current semantic authorization changes without workflow internals.

relationships.contract: effective Policy Rules with governed subject/provenance
relationships.purpose: Provide current semantic authorization for technical materialization.

relationships.contract: applicable Component placements / ResourceRefs with resolution state
relationships.purpose: Resolve governed logical deployments to current access-domain placements.

relationships.contract: technical realization as-of selected logical time
relationships.purpose: Resolve referenced Resources to technical realization without moving Resource ownership.
Identify candidate enforcement targets and locators.
Publish comparable target-specific required effective policy.

relationships.contract: provider-native configured policy for explicit comparison scope

invariants: Bounded Context is not a deployment unit.
Business Need does not authorize access.
ACC owns Application/Component/Interaction semantics and not deployment placement.
Application Deployment owns logical deployment identity and Component-to-Resource placement truth.
Resource Catalogue owns Resource identity/lifecycle, scope affiliation/responsibility and technical realization.
ApplicationDeployment identity survives ordinary scaling/migration/placement replacement while logical deployment continuity is preserved.
GovernedInteractionSubject identity is InteractionContractRevisionRef + source/destination ApplicationDeploymentRef; technical realization changes do not redefine it.
Grant requires source-side and destination-side consent; either authorized side may withdraw current consent.
Authority Management owns effective action authority; consumers own decisions made using that authority.
Required Policy Materialization is derived composition; unresolved is not empty required policy or APR drift.
Technical evidence is not authorization and is not automatically current/complete configured policy.
No Shared Kernel is accepted between target Bounded Contexts.
open_strategic_questions: S1: what product constraints determine selectable source/destination ApplicationDeployment pairs for an Access Request?
S1: when placement or Resource Scope Affiliation changes alter approval obligations, does existing authorization remain valid, require reapproval, warn, or withdraw?
S1: when several Responsibility Scopes are simultaneously applicable to one governance side, what approval obligations are required?
tactical_open_questions: Exact public network-realization/exposure contract between Application Deployment and Resource Catalogue; do not assume ResourceEndpointRef or DeploymentEndpointBinding.
Exact ApplicationDeployment lifecycle/status vocabulary and move-versus-replacement rules.
Whether multiple access-domain placements of the same Component on the same Resource require distinct identity.
